desc: Write complete Python solution: stdin reading, KMP prefix function over rev(S) + '#' + S, answer = S + reverse(S[:n−k]), print to stdout.
Verify correctness on samples (ABC→ABCBA, TREE→TREERT, Z→Z) and edge cases (already-palindrome, single char).
Performance-test with n=500000 (random and all-same-character strings) to confirm O(n) time and acceptable memory.
